notes.title: Frigore - BETA access update v2.1
notes.notes:
[b][u]Frigore - BETA access update  v2.1[/u][/b]

Hello everyone ! I hope every single one of you are doing great ! 

This weeks update consist of major changes to the game and we are almost ready to switch to the RPG element i have been working for a long time. This weeks update includes the following :

[list]
[*]Completely changed the zombie skins/reworked 
[*]Changed zombie animations
[*]Reworked surface with proper sound effects/footsteps
[*]Made zombies walk slower with new animations 
[*]Remastered the dynamic weather, staring day and cycling through night
[*]Ambience to day/evening/night sounds added
[*]Ambience music during gameplay added
[*]Added rigid-bodies to dead zombies and changed some gravity settings
[*]Buffed the pistol from 30 to 40 base damage
[*]Small graphics changes for better visuals 
[/list]

Until next update , expect to see the new gun and a more expanded area with objectives ! 

Take care everyone :)

notes.title: Frigore update v1.4
notes.notes:
Hello every one ! 

Its been a while since last update , but now the new area with the new encounter is on the game ! 

[u][b]PLEASE READ[/b][/u]

When you unlock the door to enter the new area , make sure :
[list]
[*]You have plenty of ammo + items
[*]You save the game , because if you die (and you will) you will lose items in the new area and be unable to get back to reclaim them !
[*]Don't get nervous
[/list]

[b][u]UPDATE v1.4 INCLUDES[/u][/b]

[list]
[*]New area that is located in the tunnels , far end where the locked door is
[*]The key to access the door that can be found in the radio tower
[*]New enemy with 30,000 lifepoints (a normal zombie has 150)
[*]Improved performance (especially in the new area)
[*]New out of map Easter eggs for the hunters (props YouTube channel : JustJack)
[*]New zombie attack sounds
[*]increased shotgun damage output and headshot damage
[/list]

Im still working every day on the game , bugs are everywhere and im trying to fix everything and keep everyone happy ! Thank you everyone for the wonderful reviews and discussions we have together ! :)
A bigger update is on the way :D 

Take care , stay safe !!!

notes.title: Update v1.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone , i hope  you are all having a great weekend and i hope all of you are safe ! :) 

This update is focused on all the suggestions and changes all of you wanted in the game !

[b][u]New additions[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Stamina bar (So you cannot endlessly outrun and kite the zombies)
[*]New hidden key + door that opens the next map (Once open , the next area is blocked by barrels. No need to go searching for it, in the next update the hint to find the key will be revealed in game.)
[*]Loud scream from zombies that detect you and come to attack
[/list]

[u][b]Buffs/Nerfs[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Flashlight is now incredibly useful (3x faster take out time and hide)
[*]Flashlight is brighter and has increased beam range
[*]Reduced zombie damage from [b]25-50[/b] to [b]20-40[/b]
[*]Zombies react to shots from [b]greater[/b] distance (Bring the axe in more use)
[*]Shotgun shell ejection speed from [b]100[/b] to [b]200[/b]
[*]Pistol minor damage decrease from [b]40[/b] to [b]35[/b]
[/list]

[u][b]Changes and reworks[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Removed running and walking head-bob (No dizzy shakes)
[*]Removed jump sounds (If people want them back in the future i will add them again)
[*]Removed weapon sway and now the aiming is super clean and very useful to ADS(aim down sight)
[*]Radio tower zombie silhouette removed (jumpscare is still there)
[/list]

[u][b]Fixes/Bugs[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Fixed main menu bug that let you fly and look around
[/list]

[u][b]Performance[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Did some shadow and light adjustments, please let me know if the performance is now better !
[/list]

Waiting for more suggestions and everything you want in the game !!! Please let me know. Im working on the "building mechanics" and the new map right now ! :) Will provide screenshots within the next week ! 

Take care every one !!!

notes.title: UPDATE V1.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone ! :)

Today i fixed the LAG issues some of you had. The issue was low framerate sometimes and low framerate on low spec PC's. I added occlusion culling to the camera so it wont render all the map at once. Also changed the graphic tier from [b]low[/b] to [b]high[/b] as a default now that the framerate is better !

This was a small daily update so make sure you read the [b][u]V1.0[/u][/b] and [b][u]V1.1[/u][/b] for the upcoming releases and the yesterdays nerfs and buffs in the game! 

I want to thank every single one of you that left me a review and point out so many things that needed to be fixed ! I appreciate everyone of you :) Give me the time i need and i will provide you with a great free to play game !

Take care and stay safe !

notes.title: UPDATE v1.0 : RELEASE
notes.notes:
Release v1.0 is almost here ! 
With the new year 2022 and a brand new released game , i will be explaining to you what to expect and when to expect most of the future updates of the game .

First things first i want to make clear that the Release v1.0 will [b]NOT[/b] be the final representation of the game, and more of an unfished product of the game before going live with the Full release after the early Access.
[u][b]From 14 JAN until 17 JAN : [/b][/u]
[list]
[*] I will be monitoring : [u]Bugs[/u] - [u]Exploits[/u] - [u]Reviews[/u] , and make sure [b]ALL[/b] of them are fixed !
[/list][list]
[*] Will start working on the early access suggestions that reviews will give.
[/list][list]
[*] Share the next update that will be the building update (Screenshots and Gameplay)
[/list]

[u][b]From 18 JAN until 21 JAN : [/b][/u]
[list]
[*] The [b]building[/b] update will go live ! 
[/list][list]
[*] Demonstrate future plans for the game + new weapons + new items + new enemies.
[/list][list]
[*] Give footage of the new [b]DLC[/b] ([i]Downloadable content[/i])
[/list]

[u][b]From 21 JAN until 31 JAN : [/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Getting closer to the full release , the next big update will come by that time (featuring the CO-OP multiplayer mode) !
[/list][list]
[*] New map + area will be available
[/list][list]
[*] New weapon + Item release.
[/list]

[u][b]From FEB to MAR :[/b][/u]
EXPECT THE FINAL AND FULL RELEASE OF THE GAME , FEATURING WEEKLY UPDATES


Thank you everyone for your support !
I hope every single on of you stays safe during these difficult times , dealing with the pandemic ! 
Better days will come !
